jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents What to expect. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. We try to make the simple thing easy and the hard thing possible. We grow together.

Your voice matters here. We are proud of the product and of how we build it. You will own a clear area of work and see it through from start to finish. We grow together. Questions are welcome at every step. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. With time set aside for learning, We care about doing the work well and about each other. We grow together.

About The Role

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. You will help improve the habits the group relies on. We keep things simple. We would love to hear from you. We care about doing the work well and about each other. Feedback here is frequent and kind. Expect a friendly process with quick replies. We keep things simple. Details follow below. We grow together.

  • Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, with honest and regular feedback, Your ideas will be heard from the first week. We grow together

 

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • Your voice matters here. Thank you for reading. We hold a high bar and give each other the help to meet it. Your voice matters here

  • Kindness and candour go together here. Our customers count on us every day so quality is part of the job. We keep things simple

  • Thank you for reading. We read every application with care. You will have the time and support to do your best work. Thank you for reading

  • Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

  • Details follow below. We keep meetings short and leave room for focused work. We grow together

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

  • The work is varied and no two weeks look quite the same

 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

  • Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software
